verdict_reason: The listed/unlisted test is sound, but the empty-input test cannot fail when the guard it covers is removed.

todos.issue: 'Should return nothing when there is nothing to check' runs in stub mode, where lines.filter over an empty array already returns []. Deleting the lines.length === 0 guard in species-check.js (lines 19-21) leaves this test green; the guard's real effect, not calling reference-data for an empty submission, is asserted nowhere (real-mode.test.js has no empty-lines case).
todos.fix: Must: a test turns red when the empty-lines guard is removed, by proving no species-check request is sent for an empty list. One way: move the case into real-mode.test.js under STUB_MODE=false and assert fetchMocker.requests() is empty alongside the [] result; delete the stub-mode copy.
